seo.title: Stop receiving the letter | Awrea Paris
seo.description: Unsubscribe from the Awrea Paris letter in one click.

texte: One click, and the Maison’s letter stops arriving in your inbox. The emails that follow an order, from its making to its delivery, will still reach you.

fait.texte: You will no longer receive the Maison’s letter. If you change your mind, you can sign up again at the bottom of every page of the site.

invalide.titre: This link is no longer valid
invalide.texte: Write to us at {email} and we will take you off the list ourselves.

erreur: The unsubscribe did not go through. Try again in a moment, or write to us.
